mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trading_strategy (account_id, symbol, side, strategy_type, fast_window, slow_window, band_period, band_multiplier, order_quantity, max_spend, max_position_size, max_consecutive_failures, consecutive_failures, status, created_on, updated_on) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{symbol}, #{side}, #{strategyType}, #{fastWindow}, #{slowWindow}, #{bandPeriod}, #{bandMultiplier}, #{orderQuantity}, #{maxSpend}, #{maxPositionSize}, #{maxConsecutiveFailures}, 0, 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM trading_strategy WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY created_on DESC
SELECT * FROM trading_strategy WHERE symbol = #{symbol} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trading_strategy WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.update: UPDATE trading_strategy SET consecutive_failures = consecutive_failures + 1, status = CASE WHEN consecutive_failures + 1 >= max_consecutive_failures THEN 'DISABLED' ELSE status END, disabled_reason = CASE WHEN consecutive_failures + 1 >= max_consecutive_failures THEN #{disabledReason} ELSE disabled_reason END, updated_on = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
